skill.name: internationalizing-websites
skill.description: Add internationalization support to Next.js websites. The skill guides locale files, next-intl configuration, hreflang, sitemaps, translations, and international SEO checks.
skill.summary: Internationalize Next.js sites with locale files, hreflang, sitemaps, and translation QA.
skill.author: ZhanlinCui

security_audit.summary: Static high alerts were mostly parser false positives from Markdown examples, JavaScript template literals, RegExp.exec(), and translated prose. No prompt injection, secret access, command execution, or data exfiltration was found, but one script injects Word2MD-specific schema content into generic projects.

remediation.suggestion: Replace hardcoded Word2MD schema and pricing text with user-provided source content before writing locale files.
Add dry-run mode, backups, and a changed-file summary for scripts that update project files.
Mark curl commands as optional checks and tell users to run them only against sites they control.

content.value_statement: Teams often miss locale files, hreflang links, and international SEO checks when adding languages. This skill provides a practical Next.js workflow for localization and SEO validation.
actual_capabilities: Copies English translation files into configured target locale files through the included language script.
Updates next-intl locale and request configuration examples for language routing.
Generates sitemap hreflang entries from existing sitemap URLs.
Provides hreflang implementation patterns and validation checks.
Lists locale codes, regional variants, and RTL handling notes.
Adds localized schema and pricing fields from a predefined translation map.
limitations: Scripts assume a Next.js project that uses next-intl and specific i18n directories.
Translation text still needs human review by native speakers.
The schema translation script contains product-specific Word2MD content.
The workflow does not connect to professional translation platforms.

best_practices: Back up translation files before running scripts that modify project content.

faq.question: What framework does this skill target?
faq.answer: It targets Next.js projects that use next-intl and JSON translation files.

faq.question: Does it translate all content automatically?
faq.answer: No. It provides workflow support and predefined examples. Human review is still required.

faq.question: Can it help with hreflang tags?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes hreflang patterns, sitemap guidance, and validation steps.

faq.question: Does it modify project files?
faq.answer: Yes. The included scripts can copy translation files and update configuration files.

faq.question: Is it safe for any website?
faq.answer: Review scripts first. One schema script contains Word2MD-specific content that may not fit other sites.

faq.question: Which AI tools are supported?
faq.answer: The marketplace metadata lists Claude, Codex, and Claude Code as supported tools.
